call_chain_summary: Owner module names are interned in the registry. Typed registration derives <plugin>.events, validates namespace/version/payload, rejects duplicate TypeId, updates the derived catalog, and stores an owner-scoped registration. Runtime catalog merge selects modules and re-interns target owners. apply_to_world finalizes and clones each action into a World. Mirrored registration carries an Arc-backed callback and World mirror subscriptions invoke it on reader-count changes; owner revocation removes registry slots but does not erase already-applied World state.
callers: RuntimePlugin::register is collected by RuntimePluginRegistrationReport::from_plugin; catalog merge rebinds owner and clones entries; apply_to_world clones registrations into each World; World event mirror owns applied mirror registration and reader callbacks

contributions/extension.rs:71-78 按选中模块过滤事件并重绑定目标 owner；apply_to_world.rs:51-59 克隆 EventRegistration 进入逐 World 安装计划；scene/world/event_mirror.rs:14-21 再将镜像注册存入目标 World。这些调用支撑新增的克隆与安装时机说明。

scene/event_mirror/registration.rs:64-97 将工厂及读者回调存为 Arc；World::subscribe_runtime_event_mirror 先建立连接、增加 reader count 再通知，通知失败回滚并再通知。runtime_extension_registry.rs:221-289 只撤销本表贡献，返回的 ownership 和既有 World/计划副本仍有独立寿命。注释没有承诺动态库由 Rust 静态生命周期约束固定驻留。
命名空间首段与包级 runtime owner 分别由 event_registration.rs 的 namespace helper 与 register.rs:271-280 实现；事件清单沿用 package catalog 校验。清楚的 getter、Debug 与本地 namespace 测试无需追加复述说明。
diagnostics.rs:21-37 的 Display 输出与旧 join 实现逐字节相同；分配测试覆盖空诊断、空项、中文及 emoji，交替性能样本的真实断言是 optimized P95 不超过 legacy P95 的 110%。主审修正了这处新注释措辞，并把两个私有对象的新说明改用普通 //。
最终两个源码的 baseline 到当前增量均只插入 19 行注释，原业务与旧注释字节、BOM/EOL 保留；主审修订的两个文件实际 rustfmt stdout 解析均 exit 0，结构检查无违规。原 agent 结果按原哈希另存，未将旧检查的哈希替换为新检查证据；最终覆盖使用当前后像和主审修订出处。含预存差异的整文件归属与受管提交仍待处理。
